read.en: Rockwell rose 0.9% on Oct 26 to $429.89, trading $427.15–433.78 on light volume (0.61 times average). It is above the rising 5-day ($429.2), falling 10-day ($427.5) and rising 200-day ($426.5) averages, and below the rising 30-day ($430.9) and falling 100-day ($446.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, near a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($440.80), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 10月26日上涨 0.9%，收于 $429.89，盘中区间 $427.15–433.78，成交清淡（为平均水平的 0.61 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日（$429.2）、下行的 10 日（$427.5）和上行的 200 日均线（$426.5）上方，低于上行的 30 日（$430.9）和下行的 100 日均线（$446.6）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$440.80），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close cleared the 5, 10 and 200-day averages; the 30-day still caps it. Resistance is $430.9–433.8 (30-day, Oct 26 high), then $436 (Sep 8 high) and $440.8–441.4 (SAR, Oct 21 high). Support is $426.5–429.2 (5, 10 and 200-day), then $415.7–418.8 and $412.7–413.9 (Oct 15 and 20 lows). A close above $433.8 would target $436–441; a close below $426.5 would open $415.7–418.8.

s.en: Oct 22 low $417.6; May 19 low $418.8; Oct 23 low $415.7
